fullPassage: Near the equator, many species of bird breed all year round. But in temperate and polar regions, the breeding seasons of birds are often sharply defined. They are triggered mainly by changes in day length. If all goes well, the outcome is that birds raise their young when the food supply is at its peak. Most birds are not simply reluctant to breed at other times but they are also physically incapable of doing so. This is because their reproductive system shrinks, which helps flying birds save weight. The main exception to this rule are nomadic desert species. These can initiate their breeding cycle within days of rain. It's for making the most of the sudden breeding opportunity. Also, different species divide the breeding season up in different ways. Most seabirds raise a single brood. In warm regions, however, songbirds may raise several families in a few months. In an exceptionally good year, a pair of House Sparrows, a kind of songbird, can raise successive broods through a marathon reproductive effort.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) sharply=뚜렷하게 / vaguely=희미하게 (B) triggered=유발되는 / blocked=차단되는 (C) exceptionally=예외적으로,유난히 / ordinarily=평범하게
det.analysis:
✅ ① sharply — triggered — exceptionally: (A) 온대·극지방의 번식기는 '뚜렷하게'(sharply) 정해져 있다. (B) 그것은 낮 길이 변화에 의해 주로 '유발된다'(triggered). (C) '유난히'(exceptionally) 좋은 해에는 집참새가 연달아 새끼를 기른다 ←정답
❌ ② vaguely: 번식기가 '희미하게' 정해진다면 sharply defined와 반대
❌ ③ blocked: 낮 길이 변화가 번식을 '차단한다'면 triggered(유발한다)와 반대
❌ ④ ordinarily: '평범한' 해가 아니라 '유난히 좋은' 해라는 흐름
det.tip: sharply(뚜렷이) ↔ vaguely, triggered(유발되다) ↔ blocked, exceptionally(유난히) ↔ ordinarily

det.korean: (A) save=아끼다 / waste=낭비하다 (B) nomadic=유목의,떠도는 / settled=정착한 (C) successive=연이은 / isolated=고립된,단발의

questions.passage: Near the equator, many species of bird breed all year round. But in temperate and polar regions, the breeding seasons of birds are often sharply defined. They are triggered mainly by changes in day length. If all goes well, the outcome is that birds raise their young when the food supply is at its <u>peak</u>. Most birds are not simply reluctant to breed at other times but they are also physically incapable of doing so. This is because their reproductive system shrinks, which helps flying birds save weight. The main exception to this rule are nomadic desert species. These can initiate their breeding cycle within days of rain. It's for making the most of the sudden breeding opportunity. Also, different species divide the breeding season up in different ways. Most seabirds raise a single brood. In warm regions, however, songbirds may raise several families in a few months. In an exceptionally good year, a pair of House Sparrows, a kind of songbird, can raise successive broods through a marathon reproductive effort.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>peak</u>과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: peak=정점, 최고조 / summit=정상(유의어 함정) / maximum=최대(유의어 함정) / lowest=최저점 / highest=가장 높은(유의어 함정)
det.analysis:
❌ ① summit: 정상 — peak(정점)의 유의어라 반대가 아님
❌ ② maximum: 최대 — peak과 같은 방향이라 반의어 아님
✅ ③ lowest: 먹이 공급이 '정점(peak)'에 있다는 표현의 반대는 '최저점(lowest)'이다 ←정답
❌ ④ highest: 가장 높은 — peak과 같은 뜻이라 함정
det.tip: at its peak(정점) ↔ lowest(최저). summit/maximum/highest는 유의어라 반의어 아님

questions.passage: Near the equator, many species of bird breed all year round. But in temperate and polar regions, the breeding seasons of birds are often sharply defined. They are triggered mainly by changes in day length. If all goes well, the outcome is that birds <u>raise</u> their young when the food supply is at its peak. Most birds are not simply reluctant to breed at other times but they are also physically incapable of doing so. This is because their reproductive system shrinks, which helps flying birds save weight. The main exception to this rule are nomadic desert species. These can initiate their breeding cycle within days of rain. It's for making the most of the sudden breeding opportunity. Also, different species divide the breeding season up in different ways. Most seabirds raise a single brood. In warm regions, however, songbirds may raise several families in a few months. In an exceptionally good year, a pair of House Sparrows, a kind of songbird, can raise successive broods through a marathon reproductive effort.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>raise</u>와 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: raise=기르다, 키우다 / abandon=버리다, 방치하다 / rear=기르다(유의어 함정) / feed=먹이다(유의어 함정) / nurture=양육하다(유의어 함정)
det.analysis:
✅ ① abandon: 새끼를 '기르다(raise)'의 반대는 '버리다·방치하다(abandon)'이다 ←정답
❌ ② rear: 기르다 — raise와 같은 뜻이라 반의어 아님
❌ ③ feed: 먹이다 — 기르는 행동의 일부라 반대가 아님
❌ ④ nurture: 양육하다 — raise의 유의어라 함정
det.tip: raise(기르다) ↔ abandon(버리다). rear/feed/nurture는 유의어라 반의어 아님

questions.passage:
(A) If all goes well, birds raise their young when the food <u>supply</u> is at its peak.

(B) During the war, several countries agreed to <u>supply</u> weapons and food to their allies.
questions.stem: 밑줄 친 supply의 (A)와 (B)에서의 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: supply: (A) 공급(량), 명사 (B) 공급하다, 동사
det.analysis:
✅ ③ (A) the food supply는 '먹이의 공급(량)'이라는 명사다. (B) agreed to supply weapons는 '무기를 공급하다'라는 동사다 ←정답
❌ ① (B) supply를 '부족'으로 본 것은 정반대
❌ ② (A) '수요'가 아니라 '공급'이다
❌ ④ (A) '요구'가 아니라 '공급량', (B) '제공받다'가 아니라 '제공하다'
det.tip: supply 다의어: (A) food supply(공급량·명사) (B) supply weapons(공급하다·동사)

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "an imaginary line around the middle of the Earth, an equal distance from the North and South Poles"

det.korean: coast=해안 / border=국경 / horizon=지평선 / equator=적도
det.analysis:
❌ ① coast: 해안 — 정의(지구 한가운데를 도는 가상의 선)와 무관
❌ ② border: 국경 — 나라 사이 경계이지 지구 중앙선이 아님
❌ ③ horizon: 지평선 — 하늘과 땅의 경계선이라 다름
✅ ④ equator: 남북극에서 같은 거리에 있는, 지구 한가운데를 도는 가상의 선 → 적도(equator) ←정답. 본문 첫 문장 Near the equator 참고
det.tip: middle of the Earth, equal distance from the two Poles(양극에서 같은 거리) = equator(적도)

questions.passage: Most birds are not simply reluctant to breed at other times, but they are also ____ (physical) incapable of doing so. This is because their reproductive system shrinks, which helps flying birds save weight.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: physical(신체의, 형용사) → physically(신체적으로, 부사). 뒤의 형용사 incapable(할 수 없는)을 꾸며 주는 부사 자리이므로 -ly를 붙인 부사 형태를 쓴다.
det.analysis: physical을 부사 physically로 변환. 'are also ___ incapable(신체적으로도 할 수 없다)'에서 빈칸은 형용사 incapable을 꾸미는 자리예요. 형용사를 꾸미는 말은 또 다른 형용사가 아니라 부사라서, 형용사 physical에 -ly를 붙인 physically(신체적으로)가 맞아요.
det.tip: 형용사 → 부사: physical → physically (형용사 incapable을 꾸밈)

questions.passage: Also, different species divide the breeding season up in different ways. In an exceptionally good year, a pair of House Sparrows can raise successive broods through a marathon ____ (reproduce) effort.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: reproduce(번식하다, 동사) → reproductive(번식의, 형용사). 뒤의 명사 effort(노력)를 꾸며 주는 형용사 자리이므로 형용사 형태로 바꾼다.
det.analysis: reproduce를 형용사 reproductive로 변환. 'a marathon ___ effort(마라톤 같은 번식 노력)'에서 빈칸은 명사 effort를 앞에서 꾸미는 자리예요. 명사를 꾸미는 말은 동사가 아니라 형용사라서, 동사 reproduce를 형용사 reproductive(번식의)로 바꿔 써요.
det.tip: 동사 → 형용사: reproduce → reproductive (명사 effort를 꾸밈)

questions.passage: Near the equator, many species of bird breed all year round. But in temperate and polar regions, the breeding seasons of birds are often sharply defined. They are triggered mainly by changes in day length. If all goes well, the outcome is that birds raise their young when the food supply is at its peak. Most birds are not simply reluctant to breed at other times but they are also physically incapable of doing so. This is because their reproductive system shrinks, which helps flying birds __________. The main exception to this rule are nomadic desert species. These can initiate their breeding cycle within days of rain. It's for making the most of the sudden breeding opportunity. Also, different species divide the breeding season up in different ways. Most seabirds raise a single brood. In warm regions, however, songbirds may raise several families in a few months. In an exceptionally good year, a pair of House Sparrows, a kind of songbird, can raise successive broods through a marathon reproductive effort.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: store food=먹이를 저장하다 / build nests=둥지를 짓다 / save weight=몸무게를 아끼다 / attract mates=짝을 유혹하다
det.analysis:
❌ ① store food: 먹이 저장은 생식 기관 축소와 연결되지 않음
❌ ② build nests: 둥지 짓기 — 본문 근거 없음
✅ ③ save weight: 번식기가 아닐 때 생식 기관이 줄어드는 것은 나는 새가 '몸무게를 아끼도록' 돕는다는 흐름과 맞다 ←정답
❌ ④ attract mates: 짝을 유혹한다 — 무게 절약과 무관
det.tip: reproductive system shrinks, which helps flying birds ___ → 몸무게를 아끼다(save weight)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: all year round=일 년 내내 / only after storms=폭풍 뒤에만 / once every decade=십 년에 한 번 / during winter only=겨울에만
det.analysis:
✅ ① all year round: 적도 부근에서는 많은 새가 '일 년 내내(all year round)' 번식한다. 뒤 문장에서 온대·극지방은 번식기가 뚜렷하다고 대조하는 흐름과 맞다 ←정답
❌ ② only after storms: 폭풍 뒤에만 — 본문 근거 없음
❌ ③ once every decade: 십 년에 한 번 — 문맥과 무관
❌ ④ during winter only: 겨울에만 — '일 년 내내'와 반대
det.tip: Near the equator, many species of bird breed ___ → 일 년 내내(all year round)
